Called this company a few weeks ago and Garrett got right out to give me an estimate. he was there the next morning to cut down a tree that was rotted at the bottom and cracked up the side. the tree was right next to our fence and had our 1885 house on one side and our kids’ playset on the another side. he took almost the whole tree down from the street, and only came into the yard to the drop the last bit of trunk. we have irrigation and I was worried about damage to it from heavy equipment and dropping limbs. I’m telling you that he left the street and my yard cleaner than he found it, which is shocking in Waycross. he even included stump grinding and brought back some fill for the hole, and offered to bring more in a few months if the hole sinks too much. it’s HARD to find companies that are professional, know what they are doing, and CLEAN. I will use this man and his company for everything tree related that I need from here on out.

It’s hard to find people to work, and when they do, they often do a crappy job. Long story short, an out-of-town (not our jam) company put a boat shelter on top of 3 trees. I’ll spare you the details, but for those who know “Mama Miller” well… she showed up.
Nonetheless, I reached out to our buddy Garrett Ganas, G3 Tree Care LLC, and he was here within days—following a major tropical storm. He got 2 dead pine trees too.
These guys were in and out in no time and did exactly as we asked.
I can not recommend them enough.
Also, if you’re like me and have a beautiful kitchen with no cooking skills, go to Ganas Pecan Company and get you some Cane Pole Cafe and Jubilee Farms!!!
